ihr_packs_reason_hint: Name a role or a ticket, not personal details. Up to {{max}} characters.

ihr_packs_stranded: The current version stays on record: {{drafts}} drafts and {{templates}} response templates still point at it.

ihr_packs_why__counter-restart: A new number series would replace an old one.
ihr_packs_why__data-check: Our data would break with this change.
ihr_packs_why__edited: Our version was edited after the pack last wrote it.
ihr_packs_why__missing-link: An item it links to is not there yet.
